  PROBLEM: `_structured_cost_telemetry_line_key` only strips `\r\n`, so structured telemetry lines that differ only by trailing spaces or tabs are treated as distinct and can escape deduplication.
  WHY: Exact-duplicate telemetry lines with trailing whitespace will produce different keys, causing double-counting instead of deduping.

  WHY: The function assumes iterable input; the reviewer flagged the missing validation as a robustness bug.
- scripts/collect_workflow_logs.py:1218-1225 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [mistralai_mistral-small-2603]
  PROBLEM: `_structured_cost_telemetry_line_key` does not handle `None` or malformed/binary lines during regex matching, so key generation can raise.
  WHY: If `line` is invalid, `pattern.search`/type handling can throw instead of safely skipping the line.
